applicability: Availability metadata retained in historical comparison manifests; not a current Reviewer assessment or currentness channel.
conditions: A retained availability descriptor admits only assessments; recorded requires a positive count, none_recorded requires zero, and unanswered states require no count and a nonblank next action.
A supplied channel’s declared count, when present, agrees with ComparisonRecordBinding.assessments; shape validity does not authenticate an actual owner measurement.
An absent optional assessment_channel contributes no field to the canonical record-binding encoding.
exclusions: Reintroducing the removed current Reviewer assessment/currentness collection or its not-selected-to-not-measured composition.
Retrofitting missing historical metadata, rewriting an existing seal, or equating missing metadata with no prior authorship or measured absence.
Treating model validation as execution of a collection read or currentness measurement.
statement: Retained assessment-availability metadata distinguishes counted recorded/none_recorded states from unavailable, not_measured and not_selected states that carry no count. A supplied availability count must agree with the manifest binding’s declared assessment count. Missing optional assessment_channel metadata is canonically omitted rather than filled or interpreted as a measured collection.
